fact_english: Mudskippers are fish that can spend up to three quarters of their lives out of water. They skip around on their fins and can breathe through their wet skin.

lines.speaker: INDIO
lines.text: Ang mudskipper, isdang kayang mamuhay nang hanggang tatlong-kapat ng buhay niya sa labas ng tubig!

lines.speaker: USMAN
lines.text: Lumulukso sa palikpik, humihinga sa basang balat. Isda na ayaw maligo.
